next.reason: 1985: "CLOSE { file-name-1 ║ [ WITH LOCK ] ║ } …"; 2023: "CLOSE file-name-1 [{REEL|UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] | WITH NO REWIND] …; REEL, UNIT, NO REWIND only for sequential files". The 2023 format still allows CLOSE file-name-1 … for relative files, but it has no WITH LOCK phrase, so CLOSE … WITH LOCK is no longer accepted.
